from_notes: A combustible substance won't burn if its temperature remains below its ignition temperature.
x: A substance catches fire only when its temperature reaches its ignition temperature. At 100°C, P (95°C) and Q (98°C) are above their ignition temperatures and burn; R (105°C) and S (108°C) stay below theirs, so only P and Q catch fire.
source: OnlyIAS NCERT summary Science & Tech 08 (src/science-tech/onlyias-ncert-science-tech-08.txt) p.15 (ignition temperature; a substance will not burn below it)

from_notes: IS 19445:2025 – BIS's first national standard for bomb disposal systems; improves interoperability.
x: IS 19445:2025 is BIS's first national standard for testing bomb disposal systems (blankets, baskets, inhibitors), and it brings uniform evaluation that improves interoperability across agencies (1 and 2 correct). It was framed by BIS at the request of the MHA and TBRL (DRDO), with TBRL convening the panel; no Russian institute was involved, so 3 is wrong.
source: Deccan Herald / Business Today 27 Dec 2025 'India gets its first standard for bomb disposal systems' and pmfias.com 'BIS national standard ... UPSC Prelims PYQ 2026' (via web search); app notes 6:42 (sub 7)
evidence: web search: anantamias.com / collectorbabu.com UPSC 2026 Q45 – no official collaboration with a '30th Central Scientific Research Institute'
Rocket CA 2026 Parts 01-02: IS 19445 not found

from_notes: Development plan for the 5 eastern States ... Infrastructure: includes the Buxar–Bhagalpur expressway.
x: PURVODAYA (Budget 2024–25) is a plan for the five eastern States (Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh), and its Bihar road projects include the Buxar–Bhagalpur expressway, so I and II are correct. The corridor under it is the Amritsar–Kolkata Industrial Corridor (node at Gaya), not a 'New Delhi–Kolkata' corridor, and Gujarat is not covered, so III and IV are wrong.
source: Deccan Herald / Informist 23 Jul 2024 (via web search: Purvodaya for five eastern States; industrial node at Gaya on the Amritsar–Kolkata corridor); Union Budget 2026-27 speech (src/economy/union-budget-2026-27-speech.txt) p.21 para 89 (5 Purvodaya States); Buxar–Bhagalpur expressway: general knowledge, not checked
